in_hebrew.name: Gariepy
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Shepherd of the people
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gariepy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek 'gara', meaning 'shepherd', and 'epe', meaning 'people'. This name is a reminder of the shepherd king David, who cared for his people and led them to God.

in_greek.name: Gariepy
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Shepherd of the people
in_greek.long_meaning: Gariepy είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek 'gara', meaning 'shepherd', and 'epe', meaning 'people'. This name is a reminder of the shepherd king David, who cared for his people and led them to God.

in_latin.name: Gariepy
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Shepherd of the people
in_latin.long_meaning: Gariepy est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek 'gara', meaning 'shepherd', and 'epe', meaning 'people'. This name is a reminder of the shepherd king David, who cared for his people and led them to God.
